name: Cherish
overview: Scripture teaches that to cherish is to hold dear what God has made and ordained, rejoicing in His gifts and acknowledging His guidance in every aspect of life. True cherishing involves a heart aligned with God's holiness, as He will not hear those who harbor iniquity within (Psalms 66:18). It is grounded in the assurance of God's power and love, demonstrated supremely in Christ’s sacrifice for the church (John 3:16; Ephesians 5:25), and lived out through trusting God’s direction and rejoicing in each day He has made (Proverbs 3:6; Psalms 118:24; Luke 1:37).
